# Memorandum opinion and order

The Bureau of Quarry Safety (BQS), the Ashmoor County Sheriff’s Office and the Northvale Constabulary applied the Dunmere Trade Agreement to ⟦ORG|Quillon Freight LLC⟧.

Customs held the goods. The Grand Jury, the Brindle County Jail and the Board were told. BQS then wrote to NASA and to the Central Office.

The claimants rely on the Brussels I Regulation, the Lugano Convention, the Ashmoor Executive Law and the Ashmoor Freight Safety Act, 12 A.S.C. § 41, et seq. (hereinafter, the “AFSA”). The AFSA does not reach ⟦ORG|Treaty Oak Capital LLC⟧ or ⟦ORG|Customs Brokers Inc⟧.

The motion is denied.
